edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC6 Business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8 are in force
    When the tests of section 16 run
    Then each rule BR1 to BR11 is asserted by the criterion or test named in its Covered by column

  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (BR8; R-WO-05 timer)
    Given the retry limit is read as a parameter with its version
    When a pack build activity fails and is retried
    Then the activity is retried no more than the retry limit
    When the pack build activity runs past the 3 working day timer of R-WO-05
    Then the timeout outcome is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S7-E6021-APP-AC7)

  Scenario: AC8 Disallowed transition refused (R-WO-05 machine)
    Given a write-off in a state other than POPULATION_PROPOSED
    When the event PACK_BUILT is received
    Then the transition is refused and the state is unchanged
    And no case move is answered
